overview: 33 official Qs (2008: 4, 2017: 15, 2019: 9, 2025: 5). Mostly one-liners (23 with options, 5 stem-only) plus negative, statement and CM-chronology Qs. Post-1956 social/cultural/political events = 23 Qs; the 1953–56 merger steps (Visalandhra, SRC, Gentlemen's Agreement) are smaller but steady. Year and 'who was CM/first holder' facts dominate.

possibility.angle: Events leading to Andhra Pradesh (Andhra State CMs, Burgula's change of stand)
possibility.what_they_ask: Last CM of Andhra State, the year a Hyderabad leader changed stance
Who supported Visalandhra at the 1954 session, Communist stance on linguistic states

possibility.angle: States Reorganisation Commission and earlier commissions
possibility.what_they_ask: Which commission said what in which year (Dhar 1948), SRC dates; natural next targets: SRC members and its Telangana recommendation
Number of signatories, who was not a signatory, cabinet ratio, its role in forming AP

possibility.angle: Political events 1956–2014 (CMs, TDP, 1969 and 1972–73 agitations, Six-Point Formula, land reforms)
possibility.what_they_ask: CM during an event, order of CMs, year Congress rule broke, cause/end of Jai Andhra, amendment number, date of YSR crash, first Dharma Mahamatra

possibility.angle: Social and cultural events 1956–2014 (literature, awards, institutions, movements)
possibility.evidence: same 23-Q leaf: Sahitya Academy 1957, Ravindra Bharathi 1961, Telugu official language 1966, WTC 1975, Dubagunta 1991, Jnanpith, Jashuva, Bapu, Nallapoddu
possibility.what_they_ask: Year an institution/act/conference began, who inaugurated it, author of a work, award–work pair, birth name of an artist, village of a movement

traps.trap: Founding year vs year of coming to power
traps.spot: Options with consecutive years [1982, 1983, 1984] for a party event
traps.fix: TDP founded 29 Mar 1982; won and broke Congress rule Jan 1983; 1984 = Nadendla episode

traps.spot: Stem says Andhra State; options include the first AP CM
traps.fix: Andhra State CMs: Prakasam (first), Bezawada Gopala Reddy (last); Sanjiva Reddy = first CM of AP
traps.pyq: 'last CM of Andhra State' → Bezawada Gopala Reddy, not Sanjiva Reddy [group2-2008-paper2#55]

traps.trap: Famous work given for the award-winning work
traps.spot: Statement pairs an award with an author's best-known book
traps.fix: Jashuva's 1964 Sahitya Akademi award was for Kreestu Charitra, not Gabbilam
traps.pyq: 'Sahitya Akademi award for Gabbilam in 1964' → incorrect [mains-2025-paper1#34]

traps.trap: Passing the bill vs enforcing it
traps.spot: Two successive CMs offered for a reform
traps.fix: Land Ceiling bill passed under P.V. Narasimha Rao (1973); enforced under Vengal Rao
traps.pyq: 'Ministry … passed a Bill on Land Reforms' → P.V. Narasimha Rao [mains-2017-paper2#69]

traps.trap: Direction reversal of a party's stance
traps.fix: Communists championed Visalandhra and integrated linguistic states

traps.pyq: 'ratio of Cabinet representation for Andhra and Telangana' → 60 : 40 [mains-2025-paper1#44]

traps.spot: Dhar, JVP, Wanchoo listed for a 1948 view
traps.fix: Dhar 1948 (linguistic states a threat); JVP 1949; Wanchoo 1953; SRC 1953–55
traps.pyq: 'In 1948 which Commission … threat to unity' → Dhar Commission [mains-2017-paper2#59]

techniques.name: CM ladder
techniques.how: Memorise the AP CM sequence [Sanjiva Reddy, Sanjivaiah, Sanjiva Reddy, Brahmananda Reddy, PVN, Vengal Rao, Chenna Reddy, Anjaiah, Bhavanam, Kotla, NTR] and place the CM for any event or order Q.
techniques.example: Sanjivaiah 1960 → Brahmananda Reddy 1964 → PVN 1971 → Anjaiah 1980 → 'B, D, C, A' [mains-2025-paper1#43]; TDP founded under Bhavanam Venkatram [prelims-2019#97]

techniques.name: Cause → end chain
techniques.how: For an agitation, write cause → crisis → settlement and match the stage the stem asks.
techniques.example: Jai Andhra: SC upholds Mulki rules (cause) → President's rule → Six-Point Formula (end) → 'The Six-Point Formula' [prelims-2019#100]

techniques.name: Signatory list check
techniques.how: Recall the 4+4 signatories; anyone outside the eight is the 'not a member'.
techniques.example: Andhra side Gopala Reddy, Sanjiva Reddy, Latchanna, Alluri Satyanarayana Raju → Prakasam not a member [mains-2019-paper2#71]; 4+4 → 'Eight' [group2-2008-paper2#59]

techniques.name: Decisive-step test
techniques.how: When several true steps are offered, pick the one the stem says was final or decisive.
techniques.example: Burgula's acceptance and Andhra's resolution came first; AP took birth only after the Gentlemen's Agreement (20 Feb 1956) [prelims-2019#99]

techniques.name: Year anchors for culture
techniques.how: Tie each institution/event to its year (1957, 1961, 1966, 1975, 1991) and drop neighbours.
techniques.example: First World Telugu Conference → 1975 [mains-2017-paper2#70]; Telugu official language → 1966 [mains-2017-paper2#67]

confusions.remember: 1969 CM = Brahmananda Reddy; 1972–73 CM = P.V. Narasimha Rao, ended by Six-Point Formula
Six-Point 1973 → 32nd Amendment, Art 371D; Gentlemen's Agreement 20 Feb 1956, 60:40 cabinet
Prakasam = first CM of Andhra State; Gopala Reddy = last CM and Gentlemen's Agreement signatory
Sanjiva Reddy = first AP CM (1956); Sanjivaiah = second, first Dalit CM (1960)
Gabbilam = bat carrying the Dalit's message; Kreestu Charitra = 1964 Sahitya Akademi award
Viswanatha = first Telugu Jnanpith 1970 (Ramayana Kalpavrikshamu); CiNaRe = 1988
Dhar 1948 on linguistic provinces; Wanchoo 1953 on the new Andhra State's finances
Bill passed under PVN; implemented under Vengal Rao
Ramananda Tirtha backed Visalandhra in 1954; Burgula switched to merger in 1955

anchors: 1 Nov 1956 – Andhra Pradesh formed; 20 Feb 1956 – Gentlemen's Agreement (8 signatories, 60:40 cabinet)
1955 – SRC report; Burgula changes stand to support merger
1957 – AP Sahitya Academy; 1961 – Ravindra Bharathi inaugurated by S. Radhakrishnan
1966 – Telugu made official language of AP
1969 – Telangana agitation under CM Brahmananda Reddy
1972–73 – Jai Andhra, triggered by the Supreme Court upholding Mulki rules; ended by the Six-Point Formula; 32nd Amendment
1973 – land ceiling bill under P.V. Narasimha Rao
1982 TDP founded (under CM Bhavanam Venkatram); 1983 Congress rule broken
E.V. Rama Reddy – first Dharma Mahamatra (NTR)
1991 – anti-arrack agitation by women at Dubagunta
2 Sep 2009 – Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy's helicopter crash
checklist: Andhra State (1953–56) or Andhra Pradesh (1956–)? Fix which before choosing a 'first/last'.
Place the event on the CM ladder – who was CM then?
Founded, passed, enforced or came to power? Match the verb to the year/person.
For agitations, decide whether the stem asks cause, crisis or settlement.
For awards, match the exact work and year, not the author's best-known book.
For the 1956 deal, recall 4+4 signatories and 60:40.
